notes: Synthetic fixture rows may validate code but may not satisfy the real-macro-ledger completion requirement.
A mapping is not complete merely because a sector/name suggests exposure; it must satisfy the versioned documentary human-review contract.
The research domain may be intentionally narrow, but every subject inside it must be accounted for as mapped or explicitly unmapped.
Phase 8F remains outcome-blind until the completion gate is frozen; 8G outcome research starts only afterward.
